title: Tata Steel Reports Strong Q1 Earnings Beats Analyst Estimates
content: Tata Steel announced a 35% year-on-year increase in net profit for Q1, driven by robust domestic demand and higher realisations in steel products. Total operational revenue increased significantly.

title: DGTR Proposes Anti-Dumping Duty on Cheap Steel Imports
content: The Directorate General of Trade Remedies recommended imposing anti-dumping duty on steel imports from selected countries to protect domestic steel producers.

title: Global Iron Ore Prices Drop sharp amid Macro Slowdown Concerns
content: Iron ore futures slid by over 6% in international markets today as global growth concerns and Chinese factory slowdown weigh on metal demand.

title: Reliance Retail Expands Footprint with New E-Commerce Fulfilment Hubs
content: Reliance Industries retail arm announced the rollout of 50 new automated fulfilment centers across tier-2 cities, aiming to boost quick delivery services.

title: Crude Oil Margin Volatility Impacts O2C Segment Revenue
content: Weak gross refining margins and fluctuating global crude oil prices hit refining segment returns for major Indian conglomerates during recent weeks.

title: Infosys Secures $1.5 Billion Multi-Year Digital Transformation Deal
content: Infosys won a mega cloud and AI transformation contract from a leading European financial conglomerate, bolstering its multi-year deal pipeline.

title: Tata Steel UK Plant Modernization Grant Approved
content: The UK government formally signed off on financial support for green steel transition at the Port Talbot plant, securing future operations.
